Lone Star Cyclists Tuesday Training Ride

Cedar Hill, TX · Lake Ridge · Road

Lone Star Cyclists Tuesday Training Ride is a road group ride in Cedar Hill, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:15 pm from Lake Ridge Elementary.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lone Star Cyclists Tuesday Training Ride group ride

The Arlington-area Lone Star Cyclists meet at Lake Ridge Elementary on Tuesdays for a training ride in the Cedar Hill hills. Several groups use the same lot, so look for an LSC member. Helmets and lights are required. The club also runs a Thursday training ride and Saturday rides from rotating starts around Arlington and south of the Metroplex.
